description: Tests of the 7.4.11 suite's scripting unit that pass labels-off and do not pass in owners-only-user mode, the same in both worker modes.

categories.reason: Owner mode, also without a label scheme, keeps persistence off, so the DUMP and RESTORE that the test of restoring an expired key calls from its script answer the persistence error, in the EVAL and in the function variant of the unit.
entries: scripting::RESTORE expired keys with expiration time

categories.reason: The unit's Script ACL check authenticates its connection as bob, a login created without an owner rule, which acts as SHARED without the operator scope, and the connection stays authenticated as bob for the rest of its server block. The unit runs every test once through FUNCTION LOAD and FCALL and once through EVAL; FUNCTION LOAD changes stored functions and needs the operator at a top label (see docs/owners.md#the-operator-and-top), so from the Script ACL check on, the function variant's scripts are refused with the owner-operator text, while the EVAL variant runs as SHARED and passes.
